name: grep
summary: Searches for lines matching a pattern.
description: Reads files (or standard input) and prints the lines that contain the PATTERN. The pattern is a regular expression. With several files, each line is prefixed with the file name.

options.description: Inverts the search: prints the lines that do not match.
Searches every file in the directories, recursively.
Prefixes each line with its number.
Prints only the number of matching lines.
Prints only the names of the files that contain the pattern.
Only matches whole words: “cat” does not match “catalog”.
The whole line must match the pattern.
Prints only the matching part, not the whole line.
Extended regular expressions: +, ?, | and () without backslashes.
